rationale: C02 is an especially close and recent drafting template: the child preserves the same three-recital sequence, nearly verbatim findings, thirty-day reporting requirement, and section 10 status-quo mechanism, changing principally the carrier and employee representatives. C16 is essentially equally close, while C07 adds the distinctive match of the same four labor organizations in substantially the same order.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway labor Act, as amended
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended
shared_material.explanation: Near-verbatim second recital, differing only in capitalization.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a section of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a section of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.explanation: The substantive emergency finding is identical.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the New York Central Railroad Company, Lines East of Buffalo, or by its employees, in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Toledo Lakefront Dock Company or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: The same detailed statutory standstill machinery is retained, with the regulated carrier substituted.
